YOUR PERSONAL AI

Connect your server

Bring Ollama into your workspace. Your browser connects directly to your server.

Use the base URL, without /api/chat. Remote access needs HTTPS and permission for this site's origin.
Setting up Ollama for the first time
  1. Install Ollama on your server and pull a model, for example ollama pull llama3.2.
  2. For use outside your home, put Ollama behind an authenticated HTTPS reverse proxy or private VPN. Keep port 11434 off the public internet.
  3. Set OLLAMA_ORIGINS to , then restart Ollama. Your proxy must allow CORS and the Authorization header if used.
  4. Enter your reachable server URL above, connect, and choose a model.

Demo mode is a local interface preview; it does not run an AI model. Chat history is stored in this browser. Clear it using the delete button beside a conversation.

TAKE RELAY WITH YOU

Use Relay on your device

Open Relay in a current browser on Windows, macOS, Linux, ChromeOS, Android, iPhone, or iPad. Installation options depend on your browser and OS version.

Windows · Linux · ChromeOS
In Chrome or Edge, open the browser menu and choose Install Relay or Install this site as an app. ChromeOS also adds it to your launcher.
macOS
Use Install in Chrome or Edge. In Safari on macOS Sonoma 14 or later, choose File → Add to Dock.
iPhone · iPad
Open Relay in Safari. Tap Share → Add to Home Screen → Add. Enable Open as Web App if offered.
Android
In Chrome, open the browser menu → Add to Home screen → Install. Other browsers may offer a shortcut instead.
Firefox · browsers without Install
Use Relay in a browser tab or bookmark it. App installation is optional; chat and coding work in the browser.

On touch devices, Enter adds a new line; tap the arrow to send. Desktop: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line. Your server needs reachable HTTPS and CORS permission for this app. Offline mode shows saved chats; AI replies require your server. Very old browsers and embedded in-app browsers may lack streaming or offline features—open Relay in an updated browser.
